entry.note: Verified via Crossref REST API (DOI 10.4171/139) and arXiv e-print source 1309.0796v1.

relevance.rationale: Authoritative monograph on Garside categories, Garside families, greedy normal-form geodesic paths, and cycling/sliding algorithms.

keyResults.locator: Ch. II-III (greedy normal-form decompositions and geodesic property)
keyResults.statement: Left-weighted Garside factorizations form canonical minimal-length normal paths in the simple-element Cayley graph of any Garside category or group.
keyResults.useForFolio: Provides categorical normal-form geodesic stepping backing rem:braid-fluid and Ito-Dehornoy floor criteria.
